_comment: Micro-second ALEX (alternating laser excitation) smFRET. Real ALEX alternates the green (donor) and red (acceptor) laser on the MACRO-time/diffusion timescale (unlike PIE, which separates excitation by micro-time). Two excitation grids = two lasers; each doubly-labelled species carries per-laser brightness rows q_alex = [[ (1-E)*b, E*b ], [ 0, b_A ]] so under the green laser it emits DD (ch0) + DA (ch1) and under the red laser only AA (ch1). settings.alex_period = 0.1 macro units = 10 windows/cycle = 5 windows per laser; the alternation is encoded in macro-time and recovered by TTTR.alex_to_microtime. Two diffusing populations (E=0.2 and E=0.8) give two E-S clusters at common S. Markers are off here (a laser-switch marker every 5 windows over a long dilute run is impractical; the macro-time encoding is the format-faithful mechanism) — see alex_01_simulation_basics.ipynb for the explicit-marker ground-truth demo. See examples/simulation/alex_02_smfret_es.ipynb.
